snippet.title: Talking About Something in the Nowhere - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Get to know your brand new self-aware in-game boyfriend and explore your relationship through Talking About Something in the Nowhere.

A short visual novel about romance and tragedy, we get to meet H, your alleged significant other. Help him around in your room while uncovering the secrets of your past together.

Available at: https://rhoddonbyte.itch.io/talking-about-something-in-the-nowhere

Made for YaoiGameJam2025
Developed by RhoddonByte
